aplicacao_citacao: p.2-3, Introducao: 'In order to explore the synergistic effect of BA and PP ... and provide a reference for the application of PPRAC in various projects' (ensaio de laboratorio em cubos/prismas, sem aplicacao declarada)
nota: Nenhuma vida util do betao no artigo. O unico valor em anos (Sec.2.1: tijolos de 'old houses that had been in use for approximately 45 years') refere-se ao edificio de origem do residuo de tijolo, nao ao betao estudado - nao conta. ACV so A1 (materias-primas). Colateral: a Introducao diz PP 0, 0.1% e 0.2%, mas a Tabela 10 (PPF 1.1529 = 1.5 x 0.7686) e as linhas gravadas usam 0.15%.

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.4.1 Case study: 'the West District Nursing Home, located in Chengdu ... an assembled monolithic concrete frame structure, featuring a basement with 1 floor and 6 floors above ground'
nota: Fase de uso (B) excluida da fronteira; Sec.3.1.1: 'rapid urbanization often leads to buildings being demolished before reaching their intended service life' - sem valor numerico. Nenhuma vida util declarada nem citada. Os pares C20-C45 sao factores de emissao (Tabela A-1/A-2) do betao betonado in situ e pre-fabricado do mesmo edificio.

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.3.1: 'The bridge selected as the case study is located in the Renhua-Boluo section of highway G0422 in Guangdong Province ... (405.6 m long and 34.5 m wide) ... upper structure ... prestressed concrete'
nota: Inclui fase de operacao e manutencao (Tabela A8: consumos totais), mas nenhum periodo de vida util e indicado em lado nenhum do artigo (nenhuma ocorrencia de 'year(s)' ligada a vida da ponte). Os pares C20-C50 sao factores da Tabela A1 aplicados aos materiais da ponte.

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.2.1: 'The author assessed the environmental impacts of concrete with recycled concrete powder (RCP) at 0%-15% by weight of cement' (cilindros ASTM C39, betao M30, sem aplicacao estrutural declarada; so 'valuable for the construction sector')
nota: Nenhuma vida util. 'durability' aparece so como limitacao/recomendacao futura (Sec.6-7: 'long-term performance assessments ... to evaluate durability'), sem valor.

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.4: 'the first storey of a three bay, two story portal frame prototype is considered (Fig. 2a). The frame is 2.5 m tall and each bay spans 4.3 m'; Fig.2b: 'example of concrete portal frame construction in Philippines. Masonry infill is not load bearing'
nota: Revisao critica; ACV (Sec.5, Fig.4) so da producao do portico (UF 'three-bay portal frame ... 13.0 kN/m'), sem vida util. Os valores em anos do texto (Sec.3.2: Hosoda - perda de 50% da resistencia do bambu apos 1 ano em banho alcalino, 30% retida apos 3 anos) sao degradacao do bambu, nao vida util do betao/elemento - nao contam.

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.1: 'The aim of this study is to carry out analyses of the life cycle of four bridges: prestressed concrete solid slab (PCSS), prestressed concrete lightened slab (PCLS), prestressed concrete box-girder (PCBG), and steel-concrete composite box-girder (CBG)'
nota: A Eq.(6)-(7) da carbonatacao usa 't is the service life' e a fase de uso considera 'two different periods of maintenance', mas nenhum valor numerico de vida util (nem dos periodos de manutencao) e dado no artigo. UF = 1 m2 de tabuleiro.

declarada.citacao: Sec.3.2, p.5-6: 'The required service life of the building was defined as 50 years, the same as the reference study period (RSP) for the building LCA.'; Sec.5: 'office building ... with an RSL of 50 years'

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.3.2/3.3: 'a typical nine-story office building located in Luxembourg' - Option 2 'prefab reinforced concrete option' (estrutura do edificio de escritorios)
nota: Valor gravado (50) confirmado. A vida util e da edificacao inteira (premissa unica para as 3 opcoes estruturais). O artigo segue a EN 15978 para o metodo/fronteira (RSP), mas nao atribui os 50 anos a nenhuma norma nem estudo - por isso premissa_sem_fonte.

declarada.citacao: Sec.2.2.1, p.5: 'A service life of 50 years of the beam is considered.'; Sec.2.2.4, p.7: 'This kind of beam can be used for temporary projects (around 5 years of service life) or conventional ones (around 50 years of service life). In our research, we considered the application for conventional projects with 50 years of service life.'

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.2.1/2.2.1: 'two high-strength (C60) precast concrete modular ... beams' / 'the beams evaluated in this study can be used as structural components for residential or commercial buildings'
nota: Valor gravado (50) confirmado para ORB e DRB; sem norma nem referencia citada para os 50 anos. Vigas pre-fabricadas pre-esforcadas para edificios: classificado pre_fabricado_corrente (alternativa: edificio, se a regra for 'viga de edificio'). A ACV e so A1-A3 + D.

aplicacao_citacao: Titulo/resumo: 'geopolymer binders for 3-dimensional additive manufacturing (3D-AM)'; Introducao: 'It has also been deemed feasible to use 3D-AM of concrete for structural components and building construction' (contexto geral, sem aplicacao concreta do material estudado)
nota: Nenhuma vida util; o unico '100 years' e o horizonte do GWP (Tabela 7). ACV cradle-to-gate do ligante. O par gravado e a referencia OPC 32.5.

aplicacao_citacao: Sec. Goal and scope: 'The base case for the LCA analysis delivers 1 m3 of geopolymer' - ligante geopolimerico de laboratorio (Mahmoodi et al. 2021), sem aplicacao declarada
nota: Artigo curto (8 pp.) lido na integra: nenhuma mencao a vida util ou durabilidade com valor. ACV cradle-to-gate.
